acceptance_criteria.AC-CC01-1: A finding ingested without a non-empty file, subject, or required_paths is rejected and the audit step fails; tests/test_convergence_ledger.py exercises each missing field.
acceptance_criteria.AC-CC01-2: finding_fixed can only be written from an observed_fixed verdict carrying a capture-cell citation; a prior open or fix_claimed key with no verdict in an ingested audit is recorded unobserved, and the derived success view returns false while any key is unobserved.
acceptance_criteria.AC-CC01-3: finding_ruled accepts exactly waive, require_repair, and amend_criterion; only waive adds the key to the derived exclusion set.
acceptance_criteria.AC-CC01-4: A key with two unsuccessful repair claims, or a fixed-to-reopened-to-fixed-to-reopened cycle, sets the derived stall view; a key open across two audits with no intervening fix_claimed does not.
acceptance_criteria.AC-CC01-5: Re-ingesting an audit_result artifact whose digest was already ingested changes no ledger state; two processes appending concurrently under flock produce a journal that replays to the same state.
acceptance_criteria.AC-CC02-1: The campaign checkpoint is replaced atomically (temp file, rename, directory fsync), carries a monotonically increasing sequence number, and a checkpoint whose recorded base commit differs from the repository head presented at load raises a staleness refusal.
acceptance_criteria.AC-CC02-2: Sealing an audit artifact copies every referenced evidence file into the campaign artifact store under its content digest with recorded size and media type; deleting the source worktree afterward leaves every store lookup by digest succeeding.
acceptance_criteria.AC-CC03-1: The capture script executes a declared route-viewport-theme-interaction matrix against the static fixture app and records, per cell: screenshot, DOM snapshot, computed styles for the declared selector list, ARIA snapshot, console log, and network log.
acceptance_criteria.AC-CC03-2: The capture script exits zero whenever capture ran, recording ok, unreachable, or unstable per cell in the receipt; it exits nonzero only when the browser could not launch or the pre_journal_sanitizer hook failed.
acceptance_criteria.AC-CC03-3: A cell whose end-state DOM and computed-style digests differ between the two reads is recorded unstable, and the inspector contract marks keys evidenced only by unstable cells as ineligible for observed_fixed.
acceptance_criteria.AC-CC03-4: Every artifact passes the configured pre_journal_sanitizer hook before it is journaled, digested, or injected into worker context; a sanitizer failure aborts the capture run with a nonzero exit.
acceptance_criteria.AC-CC03-5: The inspector role instructions require, and the smoke test verifies the output contract enforces, a per-key verdict (observed_fixed, reopened, unobserved, or invalidated) for every prior open or fix_claimed key supplied in the task context.
acceptance_criteria.AC-CC04-1: The driver renders the findings-owners-paths table including every prepare_approval warning, refuses to proceed to issue while any sibling-overlap warning is unacknowledged, and never writes operator-approval.json itself.
acceptance_criteria.AC-CC04-2: On a blocked graph the driver harvests unrouted findings from child review-ledger artifacts on both block paths (transfer-conflict with candidate retained, and child-blocked with no candidate), and adopts a new base only when the join and regression node sealed.
acceptance_criteria.AC-CC04-3: The repair-round bound blocks a fourth plan step while always permitting the post-repair measure step; the measure step is launched automatically when the join and regression node seals.
acceptance_criteria.AC-CC04-4: The driver refuses campaign_opened while the predecessor graph is resumable, and resume --round N reconstructs every resume argument from escalation.json.
acceptance_criteria.AC-CC05-1: One subprocess-level run through the shipped CLIs on the static fixture completes the full slice: capture, keyed inspection, findings ingest, one approved repair graph, deterministic join, post-repair capture, and per-key verdicts closing the seeded finding.
acceptance_criteria.AC-CC05-2: The lifecycle run's campaign directory afterward contains a schema-valid checkpoint, a replayable ledger whose final state shows the seeded key observed_fixed, and store-resident evidence for every ledger evidence reference.
acceptance_criteria.AC-CC07-1: The conformance analyzer blocks a generated decomposition containing a dependency-unordered writable-path overlap at file or directory granularity, a directory grant, a grant on a path the objective disclaims, a criterion with no concrete referent, a criterion unobservable from the node's verification, or an exit check outside the node's grants.
acceptance_criteria.AC-CC07-2: The analyzer inserts serialization edges for shared writers and proposes intermediate joins for fan-in above three, reporting each auto-fix; gate-larger-than-criteria and node-count findings surface as warnings requiring acknowledgment.
acceptance_criteria.AC-CC07-3: Overrides are recorded per criterion and per node with a reason string; no input disables the analyzer wholesale; the conformance report is emitted as a referenced artifact suitable for hash-binding into the approval subject.

runs.objective: Implement the convergence campaign ledger: append-only flock+fsync JSONL journal with the campaign record types, ingest-time finding-contract validation, per-key verdict semantics, and the derived views (open set, exclusion set, stall state, coverage state, amendment ratio).

Implement the campaign checkpoint (atomic replace, monotonic sequence, lifecycle field, liveness stamp, repository-staleness rejection) and the content-addressed campaign artifact store with atomic seal-time copy of sanitized evidence.

Implement the first measurer: the UI capture script (route-viewport-theme-interaction matrix, per-cell evidence with console and network logs, end-state stability re-read, honest coverage statuses, sanitizer hook, exact exit contract) plus the inspector role module with mandatory per-key verdicts, smoke-tested against a static fixture app.

Implement the campaign driver: the measure/ingest/rule/plan/approve/run/close step machine delegating node launching, approval, and resume to existing machinery, with approval-packet rendering, warning surfacing and refusal, precondition checks, both-block-path harvest, base-adoption rule, and repair-round bounds with audits outside the bound.

Prove the production lifecycle: one subprocess-level run through the shipped CLIs on the static fixture covering capture, keyed inspection, findings ingest, one approved repair graph, deterministic join, post-repair capture, and per-key verdicts.

Implement the S1-S10 decomposition conformance analyzer as an admission feature: graded enforcement (block, auto-fix with report, warn with acknowledgment), per-criterion per-node overrides with recorded reasons, and a conformance report emitted as a referenced artifact for the approval subject.
